authority: Owner ruling 2026-08-19 — bounded self-timing AssumeRole readiness loop AUTHORIZED; fixed blind wait NOT AUTHORIZED as the governing mechanism.

consumption_semantics.after_first_sealed_read: the existing rule is absolute — opening consumed; no automatic replacement and no retry
consumption_semantics.opening_consumed_by: the first sealed VALIDATION READ, and nothing else
consumption_semantics.owner_additional_constraint: if execution fails after a successful AssumeRole but before the first sealed read, the opening technically remains unconsumed, but a NEW RULING is required before another latch cycle — this keeps opening consumption separate from how many credential-release ceremonies are casually attempted
consumption_semantics.rationale: no reader credentials have been issued and no sealed or reference byte has been read during the readiness phase

control.backoff_note: then 10.0 for the remainder — readiness detection, not STS load testing
control.deadline_anchor: the latch mutation timestamp, passed in as --latch-release-epoch; NOT process start
control.non_retryable: every other STS failure class stops IMMEDIATELY without a further attempt, because it may indicate the bound IAM state differs from the package (malformed policy/trust condition, wrong role ARN, credential expiry, throttling, network/configuration, unexpected principal)
control.on_timeout: raise; caller restores canonical containment, preserves evidence, STOPs; the opening remains UNCONSUMED
control.one_way_boundary: the first successful AssumeRole admits no further credential attempt, no restart and no discretionary inspection

problem.observed: Latch cycle #2 failed at sts:AssumeRole with AccessDenied 5 seconds after the latch Deny was removed. No credentials were issued, no S3 client was constructed, and no sealed or reference byte was read.
problem.root_cause: IAM propagation between the inline-policy latch mutation and STS enforcement. The control plane acknowledges PutRolePolicy immediately; enforcement lags by minutes.
